module.hw_sensors.name: Sensors
module.hw_sensors.desc: Temperatures, fan speeds, voltages, power and clocks from the CPU, GPU, Super I/O, drives, ACPI zones and battery.
module.hw_sensors.note.cpu_temperature: CPU core temperature and voltages require MSR/SMN access in ring 0 — the PawnIO driver does that (pawnio.eu); WMI does not expose them.
module.hw_sensors.note.cpu_unsupported: This processor does not expose sensors through PawnIO.
module.hw_sensors.note.disk_access: Drive temperatures require administrator rights (SMART read).
module.hw_sensors.note.disk_unavailable: Some drives do not expose SMART (USB bridge or RAID controller).
module.hw_sensors.note.gpu_unavailable: The graphics driver does not expose sensors.
module.hw_sensors.note.history: Min/Max/Average are counted since the module was opened.
module.hw_sensors.note.no_sources: No sensors available: the GPU driver exposes no readings, the platform has no ACPI zones, and drives require administrator rights.
